function wrap<T>(v: T) {
  interface Box { value: T }
  const b: Box = { value: v };
  return b;
}
const n: number = wrap(1).value;
function make<T>(v: T) { class Holder { value: T = v; } return new Holder(); }
const s: string = make("x").value;
function pair<T>(v: T) {
  interface Pair<U> { first: T; second: U }
  const p: Pair<number> = { first: v, second: 2 };
  return p;
}
const p1: string = pair("a").first;
const p2: number = pair("a").second;
function makeG<T>(v: T) {
  class Cell<U> { constructor(public a: T, public b: U) {} }
  return new Cell(v, true);
}
const g1: string = makeG("q").a;
const g2: boolean = makeG("q").b;
function expr<T>(v: T) { const C = class { value = v; }; return new C(); }
const e1: number = expr(3).value;
function outer<T>(t: T) {
  function inner<U>(u: U) { interface Both { t: T; u: U } const b: Both = { t, u }; return b; }
  return inner(1);
}
const o1: string = outer("s").t;
const o2: number = outer("s").u;
class Gen<T> {
  make(v: T) { interface Item { v: T } const i: Item = { v }; return i; }
}
const gi: number = new Gen<number>().make(1).v;
function rec<T>(v: T) {
  interface Node { value: T; next?: Node }
  const node: Node = { value: v, next: { value: v } };
  return node;
}
const r1: number | undefined = rec(1).next?.value;
console.log(n, s, p1, p2, g1, g2, e1, o1, o2, gi, r1);
